tools.name: genppt_account_status
tools.description: Show the connected GenPPT account: plan, decks used this period, saved card, and upgrade options.

tools.name: genppt_list_decks
tools.description: List the user’s GenPPT decks, newest edits first.

tools.name: genppt_get_deck
tools.description: Get one deck: its phase, concept preview, slides, and slideImageUrls (ordered, ready to post). Pass waitSeconds to wait for drafting or rendering to finish instead of polling.

tools.name: genppt_hot_topics
tools.description: Today’s trending news, tech, and business topics, each with a short source-backed summary. Use them as ideas for slideshows and carousels. Works without a key.

tools.name: genppt_create_slideshow
tools.description: Render slides you already wrote, 1-25 (X portrait posts take up to 20 images). Use when you have the content from the user’s files, images, or research. GenPPT skips its own outline and designs exactly your slides, then renders full-resolution images (paid plans; Free stops at the concept preview).

tools.name: genppt_create_deck
tools.description: Generate a new AI presentation deck from a prompt, notes, or URLs. GenPPT researches and writes the outline. Returns at once; the concept is ready in about a minute. Uses one deck from the plan allowance.

tools.name: genppt_generate_slides
tools.description: Render the full slides once genppt_get_deck shows phase concepts_ready. Same as the Generate button in the studio. Slides take 1-3 minutes.

tools.name: genppt_revise_slides
tools.description: Edit rendered slides of a ready deck: pass revisions[] (one entry per slide number for new copy, a fixed number, a different layout, or imageUrl/screenshotUrl) and/or flat top-level placements[] ({ slideNumber, url?, screenshotUrl?, x, y, width, height, cover? }) to paste exact images into boxes wit

tools.name: genppt_export_deck
tools.description: Export a ready deck to PowerPoint (full-slide images), PDF, or a ZIP of slide images. Waits until the file is built (up to 2 minutes) and returns a download URL. Paid plans only. For editable PowerPoint text boxes, tables, and charts, open the deck on genppt.com and choose Editable PowerPoint in the

tools.name: genppt_upgrade_plan
tools.description: Preview the cost of a GenPPT plan. Never charges. Ask the user before passing confirmPaymentSpend: true; that returns the checkout link where the user pays.

tools.name: genppt_submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report, feature request, or question to the GenPPT team.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: genppt_get_deck, genppt_export_deck · Private data: genppt_create_slideshow, genppt_export_deck · Public sink: genppt_get_deck, genppt_submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: genppt_get_deck, genppt_export_deck · Private data: genppt_create_slideshow, genppt_export_deck · Public sink: genppt_get_deck, genppt_submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "genppt_export_deck" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Export a ready deck to PowerPoint, PDF, or a ZIP of slide images. Waits until the file is built (up to 2 minutes) and returns a download URL. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
